role: NestJS module that exports TimescaleService globally
detail: Minimal NestJS @Global() @Module decorator that registers TimescaleService as a provider and exports it. The module makes TimescaleService available throughout the application without explicit imports in consuming modules. TimescaleService is the concrete implementation for TimescaleDB interactions (actual logic in timescale.service.ts). No constants, side-effects, or control flow beyond dependency registration.
gotchas: This is a pure module barrel — all actual logic/contracts live in timescale.service.ts; module itself is structural only
